BrightSteps Recruitment: four website themes

The same 20 pages, content and forms shown in four visual directions. Every screenshot is of the working site, not a mock-up. Photos are labelled placeholders, and the review cards are clearly marked placeholders, not real reviews. Full concepts, specs and the recommendation are in docs/10-website-themes.md.
